title: Yield-aware rule baseline repair
scope: RuleAgent policy only; no environment, resolver, reward, observation, action, or technology definition changed.
interpretation: The stable scenario now demonstrates improved population retention and at least one completed technology in every measured seed; 15 runs completed Cooking, 6 completed Basic Tools, and 2 completed Storage.
The seed-42 depleted-food trap is removed: the policy no longer gathers sub-one-unit food and does not remain gathering at one position for long stretches.

Scarcity population retention improved and 2 runs completed Fire, but no scarcity run reached later technologies. The repair is therefore a successful stable-baseline milestone, not proof that scarcity is balanced or that RL learns.
The hand-written baseline now uses memory of previously observed cells. This is comparable to recurrent policy memory and does not expose hidden world state.
